report_contract.target_definition: daily positive item transaction-sales units, 7 daily horizons

forecast_response: shared envelope plus target_definition, training_cutoff, model_version, prediction_type=point, forecasts [{date,horizon,predicted_units}], uncertainty=null with reason; metrics belong only to benchmark report
policy_request: state requires initial_stock_units=usable free stock plus reserved_stock_units explicitly; on_order [{arrival_day,quantity_units}]; seven demand_by_day simulation labels; lead_time_days, review_cadence_days, supplier_capacity_units_per_day, storage_capacity_units, max_order_units, budget, reorder_point_units, fixed_order_quantity_units, safety_stock_units, procurement_cost_per_unit, order_setup_cost, holding_cost_per_unit_day, shortage_cost_per_unit, terminal_inventory_value_per_unit, currency, shortage_treatment=lost_sales; forecast_units must be supplied separately from realized future path
policy_response: same envelope, simulated output type, no replenishment/reorder-point/forecast-informed alternatives, feasibility checks, conservation, component cost, service/shortage/stock/order metrics
capacity_safety: Known free+reserved on-hand plus all committed inbound bound proposed order; forecast consumption cannot release reservations; unknown inputs fail truthfully.
